channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
  • Dot Line Space Art Foundation: Water Bodies & Ecology 2026 (Mumbai)
    https://www.dotlinespace.co.in/water-bodies-and-ecology-2026/
    Dot Line Space Art Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Grants towards travel and production expenses for selected artists. The call does not publish fixed amounts and does not state an artist fee or accommodation. No application fee.
  • Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
    Inato Gallery · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• G.MAP Digital Art Culture Lab 2026: Project Lab (Gwangju, South Korea)
    https://urbanartlab.org/opencall/
    Gwangju Media Art Platform (G.MAP) · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · Track 2 (Interdisciplinary Creation): creation and production grant up to KRW 30,000,000 per team, plus accommodation, equipment, studio space, production and travel support, exhibition on G.MAP spaces and large-scale public media platforms (LED Wall, city media facades), and publication. Free to apply.
  • India Foundation for the Arts: Arts Research Programme (May 2026 Request for Proposals)
    https://indiaifa.org/whats-new/ar-rfp-may2026.html
    India Foundation for the Arts (IFA) · deadline Closed 10 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 500,000 (around USD 5,700 / EUR 4,900) per project. Honorarium is capped at 35 percent of the budget. Institutional overhead, building costs, infrastructure and equipment purchases are excluded. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• TOKAS Research Residency Program 2027
    https://www.tokyoartsandspace.jp/en/archive/application/2026/20260430-321.html
    Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS) · deadline Closed 16 Jun 2026 · Fully funded: round-trip economy airfare, accommodation in a single 25 sqm room at TOKAS Residency (49 sqm twin for duos), per-diem living expenses, plus assistance for research and public relations. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• CBPS Research Fellowship 2026-27 (Bengaluru)
    https://cbps.in/
    Centre for Budget and Policy Studies (CBPS) · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · INR 25,000 per month stipend, plus access to office space, internet and the CBPS library. The fellowship does NOT cover housing, transportation or any other financial support. No application fee.
  • Berggruen Institute: Peking University Research Center Fellowship 2026-2027 (Beijing)
    https://berggruen.org/news/call-for-application-bic-fellowship-26-27
    Berggruen Institute China Center, Peking University · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · 200,000 CNY annual stipend, paid monthly before tax. Fellows are responsible for their own income tax. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
• Nationality for All: SEAP Fellows 2026 (Statelessness Encyclopedia Asia Pacific)
    https://nationalityforall.org/opportunity/call-for-applications-seap-fellows-2026/
    Nationality for All (NFA) · deadline Closed 25 May 2026 · AUD 200-400 per month depending on the fellow's location. This is a low-stipend research fellowship; the work itself is full-time over three months.
  • IT for Change: FemFirst Research Observatory 2026 (Feminist AI Futures in South and Southeast Asia)
    https://itforchange.net/call-for-proposals-femfirst-research-observatory/
    IT for Change · deadline Closed 25 Jun 2026 · Approximately CAD 12,000 per proposal for a 12-month period
